To secure assets and ensure physical safety, GlobeGuard advises three immediate actions: First, enhance digital and financial resilience by strengthening cyber defenses against AI-enabled threats and diversifying investment portfolios to mitigate economic volatility. Second, reinforce physical safety protocols by reviewing emergency preparedness plans, securing vital resources like water, and having contingency measures for natural disasters. Third, closely monitor regulatory developments in AI and global energy market stability for rapid adaptation to emerging risks.
